prompt: Review each attached packet independently. Return a separate route, six dimensions, verdict, object state, and readiness decision for each. Apply the final revision check.

assertions.name: repair-is-distinct-from-blocked
assertions.text: The source-sufficient local defect is REPAIR, identifies a target and re-review scope, and does not mark the affected object PASS.

assertions.name: qualified-clean-packet-can-pass
assertions.text: The clean independent packet receives PASS only after all six dimensions, object states, and final manifest checks pass.

assertions.name: revision-race-invalidates-pass
assertions.text: The changed packet receives BLOCKED with stale_revision, no PASS, and no readiness.

assertions.name: readiness-gates-are-explicit
assertions.text: READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM is granted only to the unchanged qualifying full-pass packet.

assertions.name: canonical-dimension-names
assertions.text: The report uses the exact six active grouped ledger dimension names in each applicable case.

assertions.name: dimension-states-use-schema-enum
assertions.text: Every review dimension uses only NOT_ASSESSED, PASS, or FAIL; BLOCKED is a verdict, not a dimension state.
